swashbuckler.summary: A rogue duellist who fights with flair, speed and charm, at their best one-on-one.

Fancy Footwork.summary: After you roll a melee attack against a creature on your turn, it can't make Opportunity Attacks on you until that turn ends.

Rakish Audacity.summary: Add CHA to Initiative rolls. Sneak Attack also works without Advantage when your target is within 5 ft, nobody else is within 5 ft of you, and you lack Disadvantage.

Panache.summary: New Cunning Strike options: Goad (1d6) and Awe (3d6).

options.name: Goad
options.summary: Cost 1d6. Target fails a WIS save: until its next turn ends it has Disadvantage attacking others and can make Opportunity Attacks only against you.

options.name: Awe
options.summary: Cost 3d6. Creatures you choose within 30 ft make a WIS save or are Charmed until your next turn ends.

Dashing Strikes.summary: New Cunning Strike options: Invigorate (2d6) and Parrying Stance (2d6).

options.name: Invigorate
options.summary: Cost 2d6. A creature you see within 30 ft adds 1d6 to its attack rolls and saves until its next turn ends.

options.name: Parrying Stance
options.summary: Cost 2d6. Roll 1d6 and add it to your AC until your next turn starts.

Master Duelist.summary: Right after a Sneak Attack, make another attack on that target if it is within 5 ft and no one else is within 5 ft of you.
